descriptionChirho: To experience emotional pleasure, satisfaction, or delight in someone or something; used of both God's delight in His people/righteousness and of human pleasure in God's ways, encompassing the participial 'one who delights in' (Arabic سُرَّ/يُسَرُّ/مَسْرُورٌ/رَضِيَ, Korean 기뻐하다, Swahili -furahia/-pendezwa).

To desire or want something volitionally, including willingness or consent to act; used of both human desire/intention and divine will or purpose (Arabic رَغِبَ/يَرْغَبُ/أُريدُ/شَاءَ/أَشْتَهي, Korean 원하다, Swahili -taka/-tamani).
